mapping_rules.no_equivalent: A null platform value means no mapped source field; never interpret as unsupported or supported without a separate qualified API capability observation.
mapping_rules.no_auto_security: Required firewall, isolation and traffic policy remains critical regardless of field presence or a nominal transformation.
mapping_rules.no_copy_native_ids: VM, disk, network, project, controller, host and storage identifiers are installation-local and must be remapped.
mapping_rules.freshness: Use minimum age of needed contributing observations; revalidate all critical source, target, owner and API-version evidence at native effect.
